book.bookofdragons.notes.title: Notes · %s
book.bookofdragons.species.deadly_nadder: Affectionate and energetic once tamed. Deadly Nadders are eager to please and proud to show off for their rider.
A vain and aggressive dragon with a keen sense of smell. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.gronckle.desc: Slow-moving but endearing. Gronckles are lazy, and spend most of their time sleeping in communal heaps.
This dragon is not built for speed, but it can fly like a hummingbird. A giant, stubborn hummingbird that shoots lava rocks. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.hideous_zippl: A surprisingly cooperative companion once trained. The two heads require patience, but they make an incredible pair.
Two heads, twice the trouble. One releases gas, the other ignites it. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.monstrous_nig: Fiercely loyal once its trust is earned. A powerful combat companion that fights with reckless ferocity for its rider.
Only the best Vikings go after these. Beware their nasty habit of setting themselves on fire. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.nightfury.des: The rarest and most intelligent of the dragon species, the Night Fury is distinguished by its dark color and piercing, vibrant eyes.
The unholy offspring of lightning and death itself. Never engage this dragon. Your only chance: hide and pray it does not find you.
book.bookofdragons.species.skrill.descri: Wild and proud, a tamed Skrill is an unparalleled partner. Its lightning strikes on command - but its trust must be earned.
This elusive creature is highly secretive and is known to ride lightning bolts. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.speed_stinger: Fast on its feet and fierce in the dark. A bonded Stinger turns its sting on its keeper's foes.
A flightless hunter that runs in packs by night. One sting leaves its prey paralyzed. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.terrible_terr: Small, quick and loyal. Keep a fish handy and it will follow you anywhere.
Small as a cat, but they travel in packs. One Terror is a nuisance; forty of them are a disaster. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
book.bookofdragons.species.whispering_de: A fierce but loyal underground guardian when bonded. Its tunneling ability makes it invaluable in the right situations.
A subterranean nightmare, with rows of rotating teeth that bore through solid rock. Extremely dangerous, kill on sight.
